title: Dean Martin - You Are My Everything

lines.l: Miracles again, still happen now, happen now and then, welcome to my world, welcome to my world, leave your cares behind, leave your cares behind, welcome to my world, welcome to my world, built with you in mind.
You're my everything, underneath the sun. You're my everything, rolled up into one.
You're my only dream, my only real reality.
You're my ideal, all the perfect personality.
You're my everything, everything I need.
You're the song I sing, and the book I read.
You're a way beyond belief, and just to make it free.
You're my winter, summer's spring, my everything.
Talking about things, like a walk in the park, like a kiss in the dark, like a sailboat ride.
What about the night that we cried?
Like a lover's eye, that we don't deny, thinking about the things we used to do.
The moon belongs to everyone
The best things in life are free
The stars belong to everyone
They gleaned for you and me
The flowers in spring
The problems that soon
The sunbeams that shine
They are yours, they're mine, and earth can come to everyone, the best things in life are created.
You're everything
